reviews.comment: Da Silva is one of the best CSCE profs by far. Very caring, will help you debug as many times as you need, and gives out HEAPS of extra credit basically just for doing things on time. She is constantly extending deadlines, too. This class is hard, but she's beyond willing to help, and you will do well as long as you don't procrastinate.

CSCE410, this prof really shines. She gives the same projects as the other 410 profs, but she has plenty of office hours and is super available, and if you ask her for help, you'll get it. She is a very forgiving and understanding professor, and will always respect you as a human being. A++ prof, you won't regret taking her for this class.

Da Silva is a meh lecturer, but she is INCREDIBLY forgiving. She treats her students like human beings, and is very understanding. If you have the chance to take her, she is a very nice professor. This class is not too bad, but 2 of the 5 homeworks she gives is horribly difficult for no reason, but she makes sure you get more than enoughtimeforthem
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very helpful during office hours, and will guide you through specific questions that you have. Lots of opportunities to get extra credit on projects and have them spill over. She wants you to succeed in her class and will therefore try to give you a higher grade if possible. Exams are also open note (at least when classes were online).
Unclear grading. Lectures without breathing. Did not get anything from this class and the projects were annoying.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Da Silva is a solid choice for your CSCE121 professor; she's very good at answering questions in class, and her lectures were very good at filling in the gaps in the Zybook. There were no surprises on homework or tests. (I thought participation should not count for so much of the grade, but this is standardized and not Dr. Da Silva's fault.)
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Da Silva during all the Covid panic. She handled it like a professional and opened office hours whenever requested by the students. The amount of effort she puts towards her students is admirable. She is an absolute role model. The only reason you will not make an A or B in her class is if you simply do not put any effort in.
Great teacher one of the best CS teachers I've taken

If you get the opportunity to have her as one of your profs, you better take that opportunity and treasure it for the rest of your life. Such a sweet and energetic professor who will explain concepts using industry-based issues

Dr. Da Silva is one of the best profs I've ever had; she's the former department head, so she is extremely knowledgable in computer science. She's a very sweet lady and is never intimidating. You can tell she really cares for her students. Always answers questions. This is a hard class, but Da Silva is the best prof you can have for it. Love her!
